batch.description: HSTU B Unit (CSE/ECE/EEE, Science group) MCQ question bank, academic session 2014-2015 (Satt Academy year label 2014), transcribed 2026-10-31 from the publicly readable first page of each Satt Academy subject section (English 15 of 25, Higher Mathematics 15 of 24, Physics 15 of 25, Chemistry 15 of 25, ICT 1 of 1; page 2 of each 15+ subject section is login-gated on Satt Academy and was not fetched). 59 of the 61 publicly readable cards are included; 2 cards were excluded as incomplete in the source itself (see source document notes). Answers are Satt Academy's own marked answers (reading-mode correct marker cross-checked against the card's test-mode answer field); content is not cross-source verified. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.title: HSTU B Unit 2014 MCQ Question Bank & Solution (Satt Academy)
sourceDocuments.notes: HTML question bank at https://sattacademy.com/b-%E0%A6%87%E0%A6%89%E0%A6%A8%E0%A6%BF%E0%A6%9F-99/all/mcq-questions , retrieved 2026-10-31; local copy sources/satt-hstu-b-2014.html (sha256 is of that 'all' page). Per-subject first-page fragments retrieved the same day via the site's own subject endpoints are stored under sources/satt-hstu-b-2014/ (physics/chemistry/math/english/ict -p1.html). Page 2 of each subject section returns {need_login:true} ('Login to continue') and was NOT fetched or bypassed, so 39 of the advertised 100 questions are not in this pack. MathML formulas are transcribed in a linear text form (e.g. 10^22, (a)/(b)). Excluded as incomplete in the source itself: Chemistry #5 (asks the name of 'the following reaction' but no reaction/figure appears in the card) and Higher Mathematics #2 (option b is blank in the source). No independent second source was provided for this paper, so content is unverified.
